model.expr: sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!="", severity=~"(?i)^(error|critical|fatal|panic)$"} !~ "^(INFO:[[:space:]]+|Terminating session: None$|StreamableHTTP session manager (started|shutting down)$|Not Found: /[^[:space:]]*$)" [5m])) or sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!="", level=~"(?i)^(error|critical|fatal|panic)$"} !~ "^(INFO:[[:space:]]+|Terminating session: None$|StreamableHTTP session manager (started|shutting down)$|Not Found: /[^[:space:]]*$)" [5m])) or sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!="", detected_level=~"(?i)^(error|critical|fatal|panic)$"} !~ "^(INFO:[[:space:]]+|Terminating session: None$|StreamableHTTP session manager (started|shutting down)$|Not Found: /[^[:space:]]*$)" [5m])) or sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!=""} | error_type != "" [5m])) or sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!=""} | exception != "" [5m])) or sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!=""} | analysis_failure != "" [5m])) or sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!=""} |~ "(?i)\\b(unexpected_errors|error_count|failure_count|errors)=[1-9][0-9]*\\b" [5m])) or sum by (project_name, service_name, environment_name) (count_over_time({project_name!=""} |~ "(?i)(traceback \\(most recent call last\\)|uncaught (error|exception)|unhandled (exception|rejection)|panic:|fatal:|segmentation fault|out of memory|(^|[[:space:]])(error|exception):)" [5m]))

annotations.description: Grafana detected {{ $values.B.Value }} explicit error signal(s) for {{ $labels.project_name }} / {{ $labels.service_name }} in the last five minutes.
